title: Mild Bean Curry
subtitle: Budget-Busting Tummy Fillers!
description: Filling, tried-and-true flavours, and even more budget-friendly than our core menu – that’s our Thrifty Feed recipes! These classic dishes are perfect for when you want to put tasty, honest-to-goodness food on the table, and enjoy even more savings to boot.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Thinly slice the cucumber on an angle. Drain and rinse the beans. Combine 2 tsp white vinegar and 1 tsp sugar in a large bowl. Add the cucumber and toss to coat. Set aside to pickle, tossing occasionally, until needed.

Cook garlic rice: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear. Heat 1 tsp vegetable oil in a small saucepan over medium heat. Cook half the garlic for 30 secs, then stir in the rice. Add 250ml (1 cup) water, cover and bring to a simmer. Reduce the heat to low and cook for 12 mins or until tender and the water is absorbed. Turn off the heat and stand, covered, for at least 5 mins.

Start curry: Meanwhile, heat 2 tsp vegetable oil in a medium frypan over medium heat. Cook the curry paste, half the tomato paste and remaining garlic, stirring, for 30 secs or until fragrant. Add the beans, coconut milk and 60ml (¼ cup) water and bring to a simmer.

Finish curry: Reduce the heat to medium and cook, stirring, for 4-5 mins until the beans are softened and the curry is slightly thickened. Stir in 1 tsp sugar and ½ tsp white vinegar and remove the pan from the heat. Taste, then season with salt and pepper.
Serve up: Fluff the rice with a fork. Divide the garlic rice and bean curry among bowls, top with the pickled cucumber and drizzle over the pickling liquid. Serve with the yoghurt and enjoy!
Make it herby: If you have some on hand, scatter over a handful of coriander leaves for a burst of freshness.
